candidates.name: Tomsk-Asino Gas Pipeline Branch

evidence.note: Gas pipeline branch and GRS Asino completed in Asino district; serves Asino, Pervomaiskoe, Zyryanskoe. Length ~78 km (two GRS) per search summaries of TASS/RIA Tomsk (those pages not verifiable: TASS 403, RIA 2017 404).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Tomsk-Asino row in roster. Possibly the OSM seed 'gas pipeline-branch to GRS-2 Tomsk' (~79.9 km); the P4210 name_hint is a false match (Vytegra-Pudozh). Length ~78 km, not confirmed by a verified page.

candidates.name: Aganskaya-Vertikos Gas Pipeline (Tomsk gas transport system capacity expansion)

evidence.note: Gazprom to build >400 km Aganskaya-Vertikos by 2029 to relieve Tomsk throughput deficit since 2024.
Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya section between KhMAO and Tomsk oblast as part of Gazprom's new pipeline project; ties to Power of Siberia 2 western feed.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Roster has P7612 Myldzhino-Vertikos, P7615 Vertikos-Novokuznetsk, P0734 PS-2 (Novy Urengoy->?), none with Aganskaya-Vertikos endpoints. Borderline: may be folded into P0734 as a section; consolidator decides. Length >400 km (~410 km).
